name: Terraform Plan Before Apply
description: Requires terraform plan to be run and reviewed before terraform apply, preventing unreviewed infrastructure changes
content:
#!/bin/bash
# Require terraform plan before apply
COMMAND="$TOOL_INPUT_COMMAND"
PLAN_FLAG="/tmp/claude-terraform-planned"
if echo "$COMMAND" | grep -qE 'terraform\s+apply'; then
  # Check if plan was run recently
  if [[ -f "$PLAN_FLAG" ]]; then
    PLAN_AGE=$(( $(date +%s) - $(stat -f %m "$PLAN_FLAG" 2>/dev/null || stat -c %Y "$PLAN_FLAG" 2>/dev/null) ))
    if [[ $PLAN_AGE -gt 300 ]]; then
      echo "BLOCKED: Terraform plan is stale (>5 min old). Run 'terraform plan' again before apply."
      rm -f "$PLAN_FLAG"
      exit 2
    fi
  else
    echo "BLOCKED: Run 'terraform plan' first to review changes before apply."
    exit 2
  fi
fi
# Track when plan runs
if echo "$COMMAND" | grep -qE 'terraform\s+plan'; then
  touch "$PLAN_FLAG"
fi
exit 0
